description:
## Why
35 fixtures keep an `.oracle.exs` twin. In 3 of them the only thing Elixir rejects is an fz-only spelling of something the fixture does not test, the feature behind that spelling is covered by other fixtures, and no test reads the fixture by path.

## What changes
Each is rewritten in Elixir form by the fz-nhb.4 rule (functions in `Main`, `IO.inspect` for `dbg`), headed `# oracle: self`, its twin deleted and its stamp regenerated. Goldens do not move.
- 00793: `List.reverse/2` -> `Enum.reverse/2` (01619 still covers `List.reverse/2`)
- 01409: `Utf8.valid?/1` -> `String.valid?/1` (00503, 00504 cover `Utf8.valid?`)
- 01494: `assert/2` lines whose values the golden already prints are dropped

## Split out: pinned compile-work subjects
00420, 00569, 00571 and 01481 convert the same way (`%` -> `rem`, a bare function name -> `&f/1`) with unchanged goldens and pass on all three paths, but tests in src/compiler2 and src/telemetry pin the compile work on them, and the rewrite moves those pins (first moves measured: canon 00569 inventory 123 -> 118, reach 00420 (68,112) -> (67,111), work_start_reason 4 -> 5, public_trace 00571 walks 528 -> 519, DeriveRecursive 34 -> 33, analysis claims 6 -> 7). Make Distiller Fast measures on 00571, so these convert in their own step after its fz-sc8.230 lands (proposal routed through the coordinator).

## Considered and kept (each needs an fz decision first, not a fixture edit)
- 01623: its asserts are the only test of fz-only `String.index_of/2`
- 01582: the only test of fz-only `Kernel.range/3`
- 01625: the only test of fz-only `String.to_byte_list/1`
- 01629: asks for the order through fz-only `Kernel.compare/2` on purpose
- 01634: asserts on fz-only `Process.heap_alloc_stats/0`
- 01129: builds a nested `%Stream{}` by hand; fz `Stream.map/2` merges, so no Elixir spelling reaches the nested reduce
- 01167: unquotes a raw map, which Elixir refuses as invalid AST; `Macro.escape/1` would remove the path under test

## Signal
`ORACLE=check` passes; each of the 3 passes run, interp and build; the full gate is green; the tree holds 32 twins.
title: Three fixtures that spell an incidental feature the fz way are their own Elixir oracle
